NEETS BAY TERMINAL HARVEST AREA COMMERCIAL TROLL FISHERY ANNOUNCEMENT The following information details the Southern Southeast Regional Aquaculture Association (SSRAA) Neets Bay Terminal Harvest Area (THA) commercial troll fishery open waters.

The Neets Bay THA will now close to commercial troll gear at 11:59 p.m., Monday, August 3, 2026.

SSRAA is nearing their chum salmon cost recovery harvest target and the THA is being extended to troll gear to provide additional opportunity through August 3. Beginning August 4, trollers may fish outside the THA in Neets Bay west of the Bug Island line (the longitude of the easternmost tip of Bug Island at 131°39.14′ W long) as part of the common property general summer troll fishery.

For the current THA boundaries, see the July 12 Neets Bay THA troll fishery advisory announcement.

Chinook Salmon Landing Restrictions for Neets Bay THA: Chinook salmon retention and possession in the Neets Bay THA is prohibited for vessels operating commercial troll gear within the THA.

The Emergency Order corresponding to this announcement is EO 1E2426.

Advisory Announcement web site: http://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=cfnews.main.
